name: colibri-review
description: A rigorous, context-aware code review & debug protocol: one file at a time, context before code, adversarially verified findings, five modes — bug, quality, feature, spec conformance, remediation plan. Prior reviews load as context and every pass hunts new findings; three empty model types lock a file+mode until its bytes change. Ships the scan ladder (owner order 2026-09-19): after a feature run every changed file is bug-scanned by a second model family and any HIGH escalates to a third — context-loaded, new-findings-only.
